SwitchPreference.android:title: Force software codecs
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
⚠️ USE ONLY IF HW CODECS FAIL - Higher CPU usage Uses software/OMX codecs instead of hardware: • Higher CPU usage and battery drain • Slower encoding but more compatible • Use c2.android.* software codecs • Fallback for buggy hardware codecs
⚠️ Steps: 1. Disable 'Prefer hardware codecs' 2. Enable this option 3. REBOOT immediately 4. Test video recording
Enable ONLY if: • Video recording crashes or hangs • Corrupted video files • Audio/video sync issues
Performance: ⭐⭐⭐ | Battery: Fair | CPU: High
